name: Yaese (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Yaese town emblem in green, orange and blue: green stylised mountains with an orange disc above a blue base.
history: Municipal flag of Yaese, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 June 2006.

features.role: Yaese town emblem — green stylised mountains with an orange disc above a blue base
